approvalBasis: User-approved motion analysis; detailed specification and initial animation implementation authorized. Final animated poses still require visual review.
assetPolicy: Read approved V7 GLBs into a private runtime instance. Do not write or replace any approved model, rig, material, source, render or gallery.

runtimeContract.entry: id, family, rank and actual anatomical height in GLB scene units
runtimeContract.update: update(timeSeconds, {mode: attack|idle|rest, speed: nonnegative multiplier, phase: optional normalized scrub})
runtimeContract.time: The viewer owns its clock/playback rate. Pass speed=1 when the clock is already scaled.
runtimeContract.returned: update, reset, summary, channels, duration in seconds, releaseTime in seconds, status prototype
runtimeContract.reset: Restores exact captured local position, quaternion and scale for all twenty bones.
runtimeContract.events: Markers describe the existing game event. The module emits no projectiles, damage, aura changes or production events.

rig.source: Approved V7 twenty-bone skeleton inspected directly in GLB JSON and actual parent transforms.
rig.boneAxes: Bone local +Y follows its segment, but parent/rest quaternions differ by family. Mage chest includes a 180 degree rest rotation; no shared local Euler hinge assumption is used.
rig.solver: Rotation-only analytic two-bone IK uses actual upper-arm/elbow/wrist positions and the rest elbow bend plane. Desired world orientation is converted through the actual parent quaternion.
rig.handOrientation: Scene-axis delta applied to captured world hand orientation; existing skin ownership preserves rigid grip without reparenting.
rig.channelType: Bone quaternion only; no translation, scale, mesh morph, material or geometry channel.

sharedRankRule.description: Each family uses one normalized trajectory, phase order, amplitudes and event phase for I–VI. Only actual rest fit, anatomical arm lengths/height and existing base attack interval vary.
sharedRankRule.fit: Ready offsets and wrist paths are expressed in fractions of anatomical height. Actual rest landmarks, including rank-specific equipment seats, are retained.
sharedRankRule.forbidden: No rank-specific attack type, extra hit, weapon substitution, reload path or alternate limb gesture.

phaseCurve.interpolation: Cubic smoothstep; independent evaluation from rest every frame prevents accumulation.
phaseCurve.loop: Phase0 and1 are the same attack-ready pose; idle/reset is the approved display rest.
knownLimitations: The first idle-to-attack switch is immediate; a production blend is not implemented.
No cloth, strap physics, finger articulation, arrow or bowstring deformation, projectile spawning or hit reactions.
Collision, floor, full mesh deformations and all48 animated silhouettes require visual review; numerical bone checks do not certify them.
Existing single-bone equipment follows its grip; no automatic retargeting of rigid armor attachments is claimed.

profiles.name: Soldier
profiles.role: Confirmed: physical, single-target melee; the current melee filter excludes flying enemies. The spear at rank I is an appearance difference, not a new ranged mechanic.
profiles.motionIdentity: Compact forward thrust; spear at I and sword at II–VI use one identical normalized attack.
profiles.readiness: The upright display grip rotates into a common diagonal thrust guard. The hand retracts by 0.045 anatomical height along the actual rest arm direction to retain elbow travel.
profiles.sharedRanks: I–VI, same gesture and phase order

partOwnership.right_hand: Spear I or sword II–VI; all weapon components stay on their existing skin owner.
partOwnership.left_hand: Empty I/II; shield with grip and straps III–VI. No new shield bash.

profiles.contacts: Both soles remain at rest; no root travel or forward lunge. The weapon does not chase the target beyond reach.
profiles.readyPose: Stand with both boots grounded, knees soft and the weapon hand slightly behind the front shoulder. Keep the left forearm in a compact guard that works both empty and with a shield.

phases.name: Gather
phases.description: Shift pressure toward the rear foot and turn the shoulders slightly. Lower the weapon from its upright display pose into a short forward attack line while the head continues tracking the target.

phases.name: Forward action
phases.description: Use one compact forward thrust for every rank: right shoulder and elbow extend together, the torso leans only within the planted stance, and the left guard stays near the chest. This reads naturally as a spear thrust at I and a sword thrust at II–VI.

phases.name: Release or impact marker
phases.description: The tip reaches its forward maximum at the existing melee contact event. Keep the arm short of a locked elbow and preserve a readable weapon-to-target line; do not stretch a blade or translate the defender to force contact.

phases.name: Short recoil
phases.description: Maintain the forward silhouette while the reach returns to78 percent; add one small restrained wrist recoil.

phases.name: Recovery
phases.description: Retract along the same line, restore the upright guard and return weight between both boots. The shield settles just after the chest, with no extra bash or second damage event.

trajectoryParameters.units: Distances as fractions of anatomical height; angles in degrees; identical coefficients at every rank.

eventMarkers.name: Existing melee contact
eventMarkers.gameplayAuthority: Existing combat event; this module produces only a pose.

secondaryMotion.specified: Cape and front tab respond with a small delayed sway where those parts exist. Helmet, armor plates, shield straps and weapon grip remain fitted to their owners.
secondaryMotion.implemented: Small chest/head response only. Cape, robe, beard, leaves, straps and plates follow their existing skinning; dedicated simulation is not implemented.

profiles.constraints: One shared thrust, including the left-arm track, across I–VI. A free fist follows the same guard as the later shield arm. Keep the long spear clear of the head, tile edge and rear cape; no shield bash is added.
qaRequirements: Spear clears the head and rear cape while changing from upright display to thrust guard.
Sword remains a thrust weapon in this shared action; do not replace it with a slash at later ranks.
Shield straps, shield and palm remain one supported left-hand assembly.
Check front, side and game-distance playback at every rank, especially I and VI.
Check exact foot plants, wrist grips, book/shield support, armor/cape clearance and phase0/1 loop continuity.
Confirm same normalized bone path at I–VI and event alignment at normal, slow and fastest configured cadence.

profiles.name: Archer
profiles.role: Confirmed: rapid physical arrows. The current intervals are already very short, so a full realistic quiver-to-string reload for every shot would conflict with the firing rate.
profiles.motionIdentity: Compact repeating draw, release and return, including the same raised preparation at every rank.
profiles.readiness: The approved right wrist is low beside the waist. Attack mode raises it to a shared normalized draw position; the left bow wrist moves to 0.62 anatomical height. Reset returns to literal display rest.
profiles.sharedRanks: I–VI, same gesture and phase order

partOwnership.left_hand: Complete bow, grip, reinforcement and current rigid bowstring.
partOwnership.right_hand: Existing free drawing hand. No arrow, fingers or string control is created.

profiles.contacts: The bow stays in the left palm. The current bowstring is rigid: string deflection, nocked-arrow placement and finger release are future work, not falsely claimed in this prototype.
profiles.readyPose: Turn the chest slightly sideways toward the target, hold the left bow hand forward and prepare the right hand near the draw line. Keep both feet fixed and the face visible beside the bow.

phases.name: Gather
phases.description: Use a small elastic pull of the right elbow and a restrained shoulder opening. The left wrist maintains the bow aim without swinging the long limbs across the face.

phases.name: Forward action
phases.description: Use the same compact draw, release and return at all ranks. Read the attack mainly through the right forearm, left-hand steadiness and a short bow reaction; avoid a large body sway that would blur rapid fire.

phases.name: Release or impact marker
phases.description: Release one existing arrow at the actual shot event, with the right hand relaxing slightly backward and the bow reacting forward. Any visible nocked arrow is presentation for that same shot, never an extra projectile.

phases.name: Short recoil
phases.description: Maintain the forward silhouette while the reach returns to78 percent; add one small restrained wrist recoil.

phases.name: Recovery
phases.description: The right hand returns directly to the prepared drawing line. A separate occasional quiver reach can be considered later only as a non-firing idle gesture; it is not part of this shared repeating attack.

trajectoryParameters.units: Distances as fractions of anatomical height; angles in degrees; identical coefficients at every rank.

profiles.name: Mage
profiles.role: Confirmed: an arcane direct hit with armor-ignoring splash around the impact. The splash belongs at the target and does not require another cast gesture.
profiles.motionIdentity: Calm forward staff presentation with an unchanged supporting left arm.
profiles.readiness: The staff rises slightly from display rest; a shared inward retraction reserves elbow room. The left wrist remains close to its existing book seat.
profiles.sharedRanks: I–VI, same gesture and phase order

partOwnership.right_hand: Shaft, crystal, socket and retaining pieces remain rigidly gripped.
partOwnership.left_hand: Free I–III; closed book IV/V; open book VI. The book never opens or changes hand.

profiles.contacts: Feet do not move. The left-hand world orientation is held at rest while its wrist follows a very small support lift; this is not two-handed staff use.
profiles.readyPose: Hold the staff beside the right shoulder and keep the left forearm near the lower chest, suitable for either a free hand or supported book. The robe and broad hat remain visually calm.

phases.name: Gather
phases.description: Gather with a small chest lift and right-elbow bend. Raise the staff only enough to clear its grounded rest; a small left-forearm lift reads as focusing or presenting the book without opening or closing it.

phases.name: Forward action
phases.description: Make a controlled short forward staff presentation with a restrained torso turn. The crystal, shaft and grip move as one rigid tool; the left forearm follows the same supporting track at every rank.

phases.name: Release or impact marker
phases.description: The existing arcane projectile leaves along the crystal-to-target line at the shot event. Its later impact creates the configured splash, without a second hand strike or an invented area pulse at the caster.

phases.name: Short recoil
phases.description: Maintain the forward silhouette while the reach returns to78 percent; add one small restrained wrist recoil.

phases.name: Recovery
phases.description: Ease the staff back beside the body and lower it toward its rest. Let the raised chest settle after the hands while maintaining the book support and keeping the open pages clear of the cloak clasp.

trajectoryParameters.units: Distances as fractions of anatomical height; angles in degrees; identical coefficients at every rank.

secondaryMotion.implemented: Small chest/head response only. Cape, robe, beard, leaves, straps and plates follow their existing skinning; dedicated simulation is not implemented.

profiles.constraints: Same right-arm and left-support gesture for all six ranks. Preserve staff ownership and the VI open book; do not add book-opening, two-handed overhead casting or head motion that intersects the high V/VI collar.

profiles.name: Frost Warden
profiles.role: Confirmed: ranged frost damage and movement slow. Rank VI also affects nearby enemies through the configured frost effect; it still uses the same casting action.
profiles.motionIdentity: Defensive short staff push; faster VI preserves the exact family gesture.
profiles.readiness: Raise the right wrist slightly before presenting the ice staff. The left shield wrist stays at its actual rest position and orientation.
profiles.sharedRanks: I–VI, same gesture and phase order

partOwnership.right_hand: Single crystal, fork or trident stays one rigid staff assembly.
partOwnership.left_hand: Free I/II; strapped diamond or hexagonal ice shield III–VI.

profiles.contacts: Feet and left shield grip remain planted/supported. Staff-ground contact is not maintained during the raised casting pose; no ground strike is added.
profiles.readyPose: Plant both boots firmly, keep the padded shoulders square and hold the left forearm as a low defensive guard. Keep the staff upright beside the right shoulder.

phases.name: Gather
phases.description: Brace with a small knee compression and draw the right elbow slightly inward. Lift the staff from its ground rest before tilting it; do not drag its lower end through the ground.

phases.name: Forward action
phases.description: Present the ice staff forward with a short controlled push and slight upper-body inclination. Maintain a guarded left arm whether it carries an empty fist or the later shield.

phases.name: Release or impact marker
phases.description: The existing frost shot releases from the staff direction at the combat event. All prongs of the VI trident remain one rigid assembly; three tips do not imply three new projectiles.

phases.name: Short recoil
phases.description: Maintain the forward silhouette while the reach returns to78 percent; add one small restrained wrist recoil.

phases.name: Recovery
phases.description: Return the staff to vertical and settle it into its rest without a hard staff slam. Keep the shield raised only slightly, then restore balanced pressure across both boots.

profiles.name: Cleric

profiles.motionIdentity: Gentle forward cross presentation, separate from the passive blessing aura.

phases.name: Gather
phases.description: Make a small respectful head inclination and draw the staff hand close to the body. The left support arm rises slightly without tilting an open book into the face.

phases.name: Forward action

phases.name: Release or impact marker
phases.description: The existing holy shot releases at the staff presentation. The continuous aura may have a separate quiet visual pulse later, but this proposal does not make its strength depend on the attack animation.

phases.name: Short recoil
phases.description: Maintain the forward silhouette while the reach returns to78 percent; add one small restrained wrist recoil.

phases.name: Recovery
phases.description: Return the staff smoothly toward vertical rest, then settle the chest and head. The left palm continues supporting the book for the whole motion.

profiles.motionIdentity: Short shallow inward-forward staff sweep with a small free-palm countergesture.
profiles.readiness: The right staff is held above its ground rest; the free left palm has a small outward-forward response. Antlers and leaf collar set the shoulder clearance envelope.

partOwnership.right_hand: Wooden staff and all attached leaves.

profiles.name: Engineer
profiles.role: Confirmed: ranged physical runic bolts that reduce armor. The approved model has a hammer and ruler, not a crossbow or gun; use the hammer as the visible focus for the existing bolt.
profiles.motionIdentity: Short forceful hammer projection with a small downward finish; ranged runic bolt, not melee contact.
profiles.readiness: The right wrist retracts slightly and raises before the punch. The ruler remains low in the left hand, away from the right striking corridor.
profiles.sharedRanks: I–VI, same gesture and phase order

partOwnership.right_hand: Whole mallet, double-ended or claw/block hammer, including its existing rune.
partOwnership.left_hand: Marked ruler remains a supported rigid tool.

profiles.contacts: Boots and root remain fixed. The hammer does not need to touch a distant target; its forward beat indicates the existing ranged armor-reducing bolt.
profiles.readyPose: Stand firmly behind the apron, keep the ruler low and slightly outside the torso, and carry the hammer near the right shoulder with its striking face oriented forward.

phases.name: Gather
phases.description: Brace the knees and draw the right elbow back a little. Keep the ruler hand out of the hammer’s path; no imaginary anvil or impact surface is required.

phases.name: Forward action
phases.description: Make a short forceful forward hammer punch with a small downward finish. It reads as projecting a runic impact toward the target rather than physically striking a distant enemy.

phases.name: Release or impact marker
phases.description: Emit the existing armor-reducing bolt at the hammer’s forward beat. The ruler and chest rune are not extra firing sources, and the action does not add an area shockwave or ground strike.

phases.name: Short recoil

profiles.name: Stormcaller
profiles.role: Confirmed: a single attack event may strike three selected enemies. The right-hand gesture should communicate one discharge rather than three serial casts.
profiles.motionIdentity: Crisp right-palm lightning presentation with a brief recoil; one discharge for simultaneous selected targets.
profiles.readiness: Keep the lightning hand beside the chest and the free left palm low. The head remains close to its approved corrected centered posture.
profiles.sharedRanks: I–VI, same gesture and phase order

partOwnership.right_hand: Entire single or three-pronged golden lightning assembly.
partOwnership.left_hand: Free lower cupped palm; no second weapon or extra lightning object.

profiles.contacts: Soles and lower body stay fixed. Existing held lightning geometry remains present throughout the preview; glow/projectile visibility is future event presentation.
profiles.readyPose: Keep both boots grounded, the right lightning hand raised beside the chest and the free left palm lower and slightly forward. The hair and headband retain their rigid silhouette.

phases.name: Gather
phases.description: Draw the right elbow a little toward the chest and compress the knees subtly. Open the chest and counterbalance with a small movement of the lower left arm.

phases.name: Forward action
phases.description: Extend the right palm in a crisp short forward presentation, then stop decisively. Let the torso follow only slightly so the lightning silhouette stays readable from the gameplay camera.

phases.name: Release or impact marker
phases.description: All currently configured target strikes originate from the same discharge beat. Multiple lightning branches on the model remain one supported object and do not independently create extra hits.

phases.name: Short recoil
phases.description: Maintain the forward silhouette while the reach returns to78 percent; add one small restrained wrist recoil.

phases.name: Recovery
phases.description: Give the right forearm one small elastic recoil, then return to the prepared hand height. The left palm settles after the chest without crossing the torso.
